verdict.rationale: ADP documents API Central, a purchasable API product with use-case templates, an API discovery tool and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect auth, aimed at automating HR processes and replacing file-based imports and exports. Nothing shows RUN specifically exposes every UI action through the API, and the source page is ADP-wide rather than RUN-specific. The community complaint about Zenefits sync latency concerns a third-party integration, not API parity, so it creates no dispute. missing for 10: evidence of UI-to-API parity for RUN workflows (running payroll, tax filing, onboarding, reports), RUN-specific API reference docs, write-operation coverage, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
